name: Cookies & Cream Latte
caffeineNote: Label: 200 mg, as a front badge and a "contains 200 mg caffeine" statement; caffeine is also listed as an ingredient
summary: Cookies-and-cream latte from Bones’ flavored-latte line, read off the can at 200 mg of caffeine per 11 fl oz — 16 g of sugar but only 5 g of it added, the rest lactose from the reduced-fat milk, with sucralose doing the remaining sweetening, alongside 7 g of protein at 140 calories. That panel is the line’s shared base: the Cannoli, French Toast and Sea Salt Caramel Mocha cans read identically. Their Cookies N’ Dreams Latte is a separate, sweeter can from the cold brew line at 210 calories and 33 g of sugar.
